instruction: A candid documentary photograph, captured in a medium shot at eye-level with a shallow depth of field. The scene is set in a brightly lit classroom playroom with blue cabinets and colorful wall charts. On the left, the girl in the blue patterned shirt (R2) sits at a blue table, smiling happily as she extends her right hand to high-five. Beside her, the girl in the red t-shirt (R1) sits facing forward, smiling softly while holding a pink toy teapot on the table. In the right foreground, the blurred arm and side profile of an adult woman in a yellow long-sleeve shirt are visible, high-fiving the girl. The room is filled with bright, natural indoor light, highlighting the warm tones and colorful play items on the table.
